Privacy Policy

Last Updated: March 21, 2026

1. Introduction

Welcome to Wayang AI (“we,” “us,” “our,” “our,” “Wayang”). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our website, documentation platform, and related services (collectively, the “Service”).

Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. By accessing or using our Service, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by the terms of this policy.

2. Information We Collect

2.1 Information You Provide Directly

We collect information you provide directly to us:

Category Examples Purpose
Account Information Username, email, password Account creation and management
Profile Information Name, organization, role Personalization and communication
Usage Data Pages visited, time spent, searches Service improvement and analytics
Communication Data Support requests, feedback Customer support and service enhancement
Technical Data IP address, browser type, device info Security and technical support

2.2 Information Collected Automatically

When you access our Service, we automatically collect:

  • Device Information: Hardware model, operating system, unique device identifiers
  • Log Data: Pages visited, time and date of visits, time spent on pages
  • Usage Information: Features used, search queries, click patterns
  • Location Data: General geographic location (country/region level)
  • Cookie Data: As described in our Cookies Policy

2.3 Information from Third Parties

We may receive information about you from third parties:

  • Analytics Providers: Google Analytics, usage statistics
  • Hosting Providers: Server logs, performance metrics
  • Security Services: Threat intelligence, fraud prevention
  • Public Sources: GitHub profiles (if you interact with our repositories)

We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

3.1 Service Delivery

  • Provide, maintain, and improve our Service
  • Process your requests and transactions
  • Send you technical notices and support messages
  • Respond to your comments and questions

3.2 Service Improvement

  • Analyze usage patterns and trends
  • Develop new features and functionality
  • Test and optimize existing features
  • Monitor and analyze service performance

3.3 Security and Safety

  • Detect and prevent fraud and abuse
  • Protect the security of our Service
  • Enforce our terms and policies
  • Comply with legal obligations

3.4 Communication

  • Send you service updates and announcements
  • Provide customer support
  • Send marketing communications (with your consent)
  • Request feedback and surveys

3.5 Legal Compliance

  • Comply with applicable laws and regulations
  • Respond to legal requests and court orders
  • Protect our rights and property
  • Prevent harm to users or the public

4. Legal Basis for Processing (EU Users)

If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), our legal basis for processing your personal data includes:

Processing Activity Legal Basis

5. How We Share Your Information

We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information in the following circumstances:

5.1 Service Providers

We share information with third-party vendors who perform services on our behalf:

  • Hosting Services: Server infrastructure and CDN
  • Analytics Services: Usage analytics and performance monitoring
  • Communication Services: Email delivery and notifications
  • Security Services: Fraud prevention and threat detection

5.2 Legal Requirements

We may disclose information if required by law:

  • Compliance with legal obligations
  • Response to subpoenas, court orders, or legal process
  • Protection of our rights and property
  • Prevention of harm to users or the public

5.3 Business Transfers

In connection with a business transaction:

  • Merger, acquisition, or sale of assets
  • Financing or investment transactions
  • Bankruptcy or similar proceedings

5.4 With Your Consent

We may share information with your explicit consent for specific purposes.

6. Data Retention

We retain personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy:

Data Category Retention Period
Account Information Duration of account + 2 years
Usage Data 2 years from collection
Analytics Data 26 months (anonymized)
Communication Records 3 years
Security Logs 1 year
Legal Documents 7 years (as required by law)

After the retention period, we delete or anonymize the data.

7. Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information:

7.1 Technical Measures

  • Encryption: Data encrypted in transit (TLS/HTTPS) and at rest
  • Access Controls: Role-based access and authentication
  • Network Security: Firewalls, intrusion detection, DDoS protection
  • Regular Audits: Security assessments and penetration testing

7.2 Organizational Measures

  • Employee Training: Privacy and security awareness
  • Policies and Procedures: Data handling guidelines
  • Vendor Management: Security requirements for third parties
  • Incident Response: Data breach notification procedures

7.3 Limitations

While we strive to protect your information, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

8. International Data Transfers

8.1 Transfer Locations

Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own:

  • United States: Primary hosting location
  • European Union: Backup and redundancy
  • Other Countries: Service provider locations

8.2 Safeguards

We implement appropriate safeguards for international transfers:

  • Standard Contractual Clauses: EU-approved contractual protections
  • Adequacy Decisions: Countries with adequate data protection
  • Certification Programs: Privacy frameworks and certifications

9. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:

9.1 GDPR Rights (European Union)

  • Right to Access: Obtain confirmation and copy of your data
  • Right to Rectification: Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
  • Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (“right to be forgotten”)
  • Right to Restriction: Limit processing of your data
  • Right to Portability: Receive data in a portable format
  • Right to Object: Object to certain processing activities
  • Right to Withdraw Consent: Withdraw consent at any time
  • Right to Lodge Complaint: File complaint with supervisory authority

9.2 CCPA/CPRA Rights (California)

  • Right to Know: Categories and specific pieces of information collected
  • Right to Delete: Request deletion of personal information
  • Right to Opt-Out: Opt-out of sale or sharing of personal information
  • Right to Correct: Correct inaccurate personal information
  • Right to Limit: Limit use of sensitive personal information
  • Right to Non-Discrimination: Equal service regardless of privacy choices

9.3 Other Jurisdictions

Other regions may have additional rights under local privacy laws.

9.4 How to Exercise Your Rights

Contact us to exercise your rights:

  • Email: privacy@wayang.ai
  • Web Form: Privacy Request Form
  • Mail: Wayang AI, Attn: Privacy Team

We respond to valid requests within 30 days.

10. Children’s Privacy

Our Service is not intended for children under 16 years of age (or 13 in certain jurisdictions).

  • We do not knowingly collect personal information from children
  • If we learn we have collected information from a child, we will delete it
  • Parents can contact us to review or delete their child’s information

11. Do Not Track

Some web browsers transmit “Do Not Track” (DNT) signals.

  • We honor DNT signals: When your browser sends DNT, we disable analytics cookies
  • Essential cookies still apply: Site functionality cookies remain active
  • No tracking for advertising: We do not engage in behavioral advertising

12. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically.

12.1 Notification

When we make material changes:

  • Update the “Last Updated” date
  • Post the updated policy on our Service
  • Notify users via email or prominent notice

12.2 Previous Versions

Previous versions are available upon request at privacy@wayang.ai.
